```{r}
strava_runs <- strava |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(activity_type == "Run") |>
  mutate(
    distance_km = distance_18 / 1000,
    moving_time_min = moving_time / 60
  )
```
```{r}
strava_runs |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_km, y = moving_time_min)) +
  geom_point()
```
## lets look at distance vs. average heartrate!
```{r}
strava_runs |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_km, y = average_heart_rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Running Distance and Average Heart Rate",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Average Heart Rate (BPM)"
  )
```
### one thing i need to consider here is that my watch often measures my cadence instead of my heart rate, so I do not think this is an accurate representation of the relationship between distance/heartrate and need to be cognizant of this in future analysis with this specific metric. 

## lets look at running pace vs. distance.

```{r}
strava_runs <- strava_runs |>
  mutate(
    pace_min_km = if_else(
      distance_km > 0,
      moving_time_min / distance_km,
      NA_real_
    )
  )
```
```{r}
strava_runs |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_km, y = pace_min_km)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Running Distance and Pace",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Average Pace (min/km)"
  )
```
### It looks like my running pace is relatively consistent. It looks like there are 3 very slow activities and one very very fast activity. I believe the 3 very slow ones are warm ups that were counted as singular activities. I cannot make out what the very fast activity is though. This may be a recording error.

```{r}
strava_runs |>
  filter(
    pace_min_km > 10 |
    pace_min_km < 4
  ) |>
  select(activity_date, activity_name,
         distance_km, moving_time_min, pace_min_km)
```
```{r}
strava_runs |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_km, y = pace_min_km)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
strava_runs |>
  filter(
    pace_min_km >= 4,
    pace_min_km <= 10
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance_km, y = pace_min_km)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Running Distance and Pace: Excluding Extreme Values",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Average Pace (min/km)"
  )
```
